verdicts.reason: SOU 2023:61 says Efos (Försäkringskassan's E-identitet för offentlig sektor) is notified at eIDAS level high but is an employee e-service credential (e-tjänstelegitimation). Nothing on the page addresses the root of a government PKI or a qualified trust service, so it does not answer K1 with 'Yes'.

The quote is the Government's proposal in Prop. 2025/26:250 that the Act on state e-ID enter into force on 1 December 2026, i.e. a state-operated scheme is legislated but not in operation as of today. The source neither states current state operation nor a partial one, so whether this maps to 'Partly' is ambiguous without a rubric the page does not supply.

SOU 2025:13 records that Medlingsinstitutet has a cooperation agreement with Försäkringskassan for the cloud services SAFOS Mötestjänst and SAFOS Samarbetsplattform (in use, not announced), and Förordning (2024:1005) om samordnad och säker statlig it-drift defines the coordinated state IT-operation offering with Försäkringskassan as coordinating authority. Together they show a state-run cloud offe
SOU 2025:13 section 7.2.1 states that in 2023 SSC's services covered about 1.5 million payslips ('cirka 1,5 miljoner lönespecifikationer'), which matches the printed figure and unit.
The page says that in 2023 SSC (Statens servicecenter) provided administrative support services to 167 agencies, of which payroll services to 143 agencies, exactly as printed.

A table note in SOU 2025:13 attributes missing FTE and cost-per-FTE statistics in Brå's 2023 annual report to an outage in 'Statens Servicecenter Primula', naming Primula as SSC's personnel/payroll system.

SOU 2021:1's survey found 58 percent (100 of 158) of state agencies have their own data centres (220 in total), and Förordning (2024:1005) names Försäkringskassan, Lantmäteriet, Skatteverket and Trafikverket as supplier authorities providing IT operation based on their own IT operations. Both support state-operated data centres in operation.
Prop. 2025/26:250 section 13.3.2 says applications for Skatteverket's identity card for registered residents are today at about 170,000 identity cards annually, matching the printed count and issuer.

Lag (1976:633) om kungörande av lagar och andra författningar provides that the Government shall ensure Svensk författningssamling is published electronically on a dedicated website and that a statute is promulgated when published there, as printed.

Passförordning (1979:664) § 23 requires the Police Authority to keep a passport register and to release a photograph of an individual from the passport register on request, so the register holds holders' photographs as printed.

Passförordning (1979:664) § 23 states that Polismyndigheten shall keep a passport register (passregister); a single national authority keeping one register supports the printed description, with 'central' a fair paraphrase rather than an added fact.

Folkbokföringslag (1991:481) § 1 says marriages, births and deaths in the country shall be registered and that Skatteverket is responsible for folkbokföring and that registration, matching the printed register and body.
Lag (1998:621) om misstankeregister § 1 says Polismyndigheten shall keep a register of persons reasonably suspected of crimes (misstankeregistret) and is controller, as printed.

Lag (2000:224) says the state cadastral authority is controller for personal data in fastighetsregistret, and Förordning (2000:308) § 2 says Lantmäteriet is responsible for operating and managing the register; together they support the printed statement.
Förordning (2000:308) om fastighetsregister and Lag (2000:224) both name the register 'fastighetsregistret' kept by automated processing, as printed.

Aktiebolagsförordning (2005:559) states Bolagsverket is controller for personal data in aktiebolagsregistret, and Aktiebolagslag (2005:551) refers to registration with Bolagsverket in aktiebolagsregistret, matching the printed name and controller.

Förordning (2008:1002) med instruktion för Myndigheten för civilt försvar § 7 b says the agency shall coordinate and develop 'systemet för varning och information till allmänheten' under Lag (2023:407), which is the system name printed.

Lag (2017:631) om registrering av verkliga huvudmän 2 kap. 3 § requires legal persons to notify Bolagsverket for registration in registret över verkliga huvudmän, supporting the printed name and keeper.

Förordning (2021:248) med instruktion för Folkhälsomyndigheten § 16 says the agency shall coordinate, monitor and develop communicable disease control at national level, and Smittskyddslag (2004:168) says Folkhälsomyndigheten is responsible for national coordination of smittskyddet, as printed.

Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585) sets the four security classes (kvalificerat hemlig, hemlig, konfidentiell, begränsat hemlig) in statute and Säkerhetsskyddsförordning (2021:955) applies them, so the classification scheme is established in a statute.

Folkbokföringsdatalag (2026:126) makes Skatteverket controller for processing under that act, and Folkbokföringslag (1991:481) § 1 says Skatteverket ansvarar för folkbokföring (the riksdagen.se quote differs from the page only in the initial capital of 'Vigsel'); both support the printed statement.

Lag (2026:1358) om statlig e-legitimation och elektronisk identifiering 3 kap. 5 § designates Polismyndigheten to keep the register of state e-ID cases by automated processing, supporting the printed operator; note the page marks the act as entering into force 2026-12-01, so operation is prospective as of today.
The same section is headed 'Register över ärenden om statlig e-legitimation' and requires the Police Authority to keep that register, matching the printed name; the act enters into force 2026-12-01.
